_doc: He Is Risen! voice cast (docs/risen/VOICE.md). narrator / jesus / peter / john are copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (jesus and peter carry the timbre pin to Miracles' clips; john gains a timbre pin to lastsupper ls_16). mary / joanna / angel / thomas are new VoiceDesign voices. Run through tools/story/voice_risen.py (runaway guard, f0 / timbre pins).

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

jesus.design: 男性，三十岁左右，嗓音温暖、清亮、柔和圆润，干净不沙哑，平静从容，亲切又带一点点俏皮的笑意，吐字清楚，像一位温柔的好老师，从不吼叫。普通话标准。
jesus.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
jesus.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

peter.design: 男性，四十多岁，身材高大魁梧的渔夫，低沉浑厚的男低音，胸腔共鸣很重，嗓门大但声音低，豪爽爱笑，热心肠，像一只友好的大熊。就算大喊大叫也是低沉的大嗓门，从不尖细。普通话标准。
peter.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，夸张好笑，但是不吓人，有真实的呼吸。大喊时声音也保持低沉。这一句：
peter.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

john.design: 男性，十八九岁，门徒里最年轻的一个，声音清亮、年轻、有活力，说话快，机灵又有点调皮，后来变得若有所思。普通话标准。
john.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
john.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen); plus a timbre pin to The King Who Serves' chosen ls_16

mary.design: 女性，二十多岁，年轻温柔的女声，声音温暖、清甜、柔和，真诚，感情丰富，容易流泪也容易欢喜，说话轻轻的。普通话标准。
mary.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
mary.why: young and warm, quick to tears and quick to joy (STORY.md)

joanna.design: 女性，四十多岁，成熟稳重的中音女声，比年轻姑娘低一些，说话干脆利落、务实，有点爱操心，热心肠。普通话标准。
joanna.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
joanna.why: older and brisker than Mary, clearly a different woman (CONTRACT §7)

angel.design: 男性，年轻，声音明亮、清澈、温暖，坚定而平静，满是笑意，亲切友好，像早晨的阳光。不低沉、不轰鸣、不威严，没有回声。普通话标准。
angel.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
angel.why: bright, strong, kind and calm; never booming, no echo (CONTRACT §7)

thomas.design: 男性，三十五岁左右，沉稳的男中音，声音平稳、实在、讲道理，说话不紧不慢，有点固执，但心地柔软，从不大喊。和粗犷爱笑的大嗓门渔夫明显不同。普通话标准。
thomas.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
thomas.why: a steady baritone, sensible; clearly not Peter (CONTRACT §7)

narrator.instruct: A warm woman storyteller, like a mother at a child's bedside telling a Bible story to a child of four to ten: friendly, lively, natural, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. This line:
narrator.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

jesus.design: A man of about thirty with a warm, clear, soft and round voice, clean and never hoarse, calm and unhurried, kind with a hint of playful smile, crisp diction, like a gentle teacher who never shouts. Clear standard American English.
jesus.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
jesus.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

peter.design: A man in his forties, a big burly fisherman with a deep, booming bass voice, heavy chest resonance, loud but low, hearty and quick to laugh, warm-hearted like a friendly bear. Even when he shouts his voice stays deep and never turns shrill. Standard American English.
peter.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: comic and big, never scary, with real breaths. Keep the voice deep and low even when shouting. This line:
peter.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

john.design: A young man of about nineteen, the youngest of the friends: a bright, clear, youthful voice, quick and a bit cheeky, later thoughtful. Standard American English.
john.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
john.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen); plus a timbre pin to The King Who Serves' chosen ls_16

mary.design: A young woman in her twenties: a warm, sweet, soft and youthful voice, sincere and full of feeling, quick to tears and quick to joy, gently spoken. Standard American English.
mary.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
mary.why: young and warm, quick to tears and quick to joy (STORY.md)

joanna.design: A woman in her forties: a mature, slightly lower alto voice, brisk, practical and down to earth, a little worried, kind-hearted. Standard American English.
joanna.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
joanna.why: older and brisker than Mary, clearly a different woman (CONTRACT §7)

angel.design: A young man with a bright, clear and warm voice, strong yet calm, smiling and friendly, like morning sunshine. Not deep, not booming, not grand, no echo. Standard American English.
angel.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
angel.why: bright, strong, kind and calm; never booming, no echo (CONTRACT §7)

thomas.design: A man of about thirty-five: a steady, even baritone, sensible and matter-of-fact, unhurried, a bit stubborn but soft-hearted, never loud; clearly different from a booming, laughing fisherman. Standard American English.
thomas.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
thomas.why: a steady baritone, sensible; clearly not Peter (CONTRACT §7)

rs_01.m: 轻轻地、慢慢地、平平淡淡地讲，不渲染，说到十字架不停顿；“好难过”温柔地放轻
rs_01.m_en: soft and slow, plain; no drama, no pause on 'cross'; a gentle hush on 'very sad'

rs_02.m: 安静、温柔；“又大又圆”稍微加重一点
rs_02.m_en: quiet, tender; a small weight on 'big round'

rs_03.m: 故事的转折：声音亮起来，带着一点小秘密的笑意；“第三天”说得慢一点
rs_03.m_en: the turn of the story: lift and brighten, a little secret smile; slower on 'the third day'

rs_04.m: 清晨的清新感，带一点盼望，不急不慢
rs_04.m_en: morning-fresh, a hint of hope; unhurried

rs_05.m: 有点担心但很实际，走路走得有点喘
rs_05.m_en: worried but practical, a little out of breath from walking

rs_06.m: 轻轻的，有点难过，满怀爱意

rs_07.m: 惊奇，越说越快；不吓人；“滚开了”带着惊喜上扬
rs_07.m_en: wonder, building quickly; not scary; a delighted lift on 'rolled away'

rs_08.m: 屏住呼吸、惊奇地小声说

rs_09.m: 亲切、有力、平静，声音里满是笑意；“他复活了”慢一点、充满喜乐
rs_09.m_en: kind, strong and calm, a big smile in the voice; slow and joyful on 'He is risen'

rs_12.m_en: bright, urgent in a happy way

rs_13.m: 上气不接下气，话一股脑儿冲出来，开心得要爆炸
rs_13.m_en: breathless, tumbling out fast, bursting with joy

rs_14.m: 惊呆了，大嗓门但低沉，心里又有一点盼望
rs_14.m_en: stunned, big and blustery but deep; half hoping

rs_16.m: 活泼、轻快；“跑得比彼得快”带着笑
rs_16.m_en: lively, quick; a grin on 'faster than Peter'

rs_17.m_en: cheeky, calling back over his shoulder

rs_18.m: 边跑边喘，滑稽，带着笑；嗓音低沉
rs_18.m_en: puffing and panting between the words, comic, a laugh in it; voice stays deep

phrases.instruct: 气喘吁吁地大喊，嗓音低沉浑厚。
边喘边笑，滑稽，嗓音低沉。
puffing and panting, calling out, deep voice.

phrases.text: My legs... aren't as young as yours!
phrases.instruct: panting and laughing, comic, deep voice.

rs_19.m: 俏皮的讲故事；“一头钻了进去”滑稽地一顿
rs_19.m_en: playful storyteller; a comic beat on 'went straight inside'

rs_20.m: 站在门口，疑惑又惊奇；最后几个字压低声音，倒吸一口气
rs_20.m_en: puzzled wonder in the doorway; the last words a hushed gasp

rs_21.m: 恍然大悟：先慢慢地惊奇，然后开心地加快
rs_21.m_en: the penny drops: slow wonder, then a happy rush

rs_22.m: 温柔、慢一点；淡淡的心疼，不沉重
rs_22.m_en: tender, slow; a soft ache, not heavy

rs_23.m: 非常温柔、温暖，藏着笑意（他知道她是谁）
rs_23.m_en: very gentle and warm, a hidden smile (He knows!)

rs_24.m: 含着眼泪，没有抬头，恳切；“看园子的”带一点天真
rs_24.m_en: tearful, not looking up, earnest; a small innocence on 'the gardener'

rs_25.m: 轻轻地、温柔地叫她的名字，清清楚楚，充满爱，只说这两个字
rs_25.m_en: say her name once, softly and clearly, full of love; nothing else

zh.instruct: 慢慢地、轻轻地叫她的名字，三个字都清清楚楚，声音温柔，充满爱，像终于见到她那样。

rs_26.m: 先倒吸一口气，然后是满满的喜乐，含着眼泪笑
rs_26.m_en: a gasp, then pure joy, laughing through tears

rs_29.m: 先压低声音，“忽然”时神奇地扬起来
rs_29.m_en: hushed, then a magical lift on 'Suddenly'

rs_31.m: 尖声、牙齿打颤，滑稽，不是真的害怕
rs_31.m_en: squeaky, teeth chattering, comic, not truly scared

rs_32.m: 温暖地笑着，俏皮；问吃的那句轻松、家常
rs_32.m_en: laughing warmly, playful; the food question light and homely

phrases.text: 鬼可没有手和脚。你们有吃的吗？
A ghost doesn't have hands and feet. Got anything to eat?

rs_33.m: 开心的捧腹大笑，喜极而泣；嗓音低沉
rs_33.m_en: a big delighted belly laugh, tears of joy; voice stays deep

phrases.instruct: 捧腹大笑着说，嗓音低沉。
喜极而泣，低沉的大嗓门。

phrases.text: Ha ha! He's eating our fish!
phrases.instruct: a big belly laugh, deep voice.
tears of joy, deep booming voice.

rs_34.m: 平实的讲故事，带一点会心的笑
rs_34.m_en: plain storyteller, a little knowing smile

rs_35.m: 固执但不凶，抱着胳膊，微微皱眉
rs_35.m_en: stubborn but not grumpy; arms crossed; a small frown

rs_36.m: 非常温柔、耐心，充满爱的邀请，没有责备
rs_36.m_en: very gentle and patient, a loving invitation; no reproach

rs_37.m: 深受感动，带着喜乐的哽咽，发自内心
rs_37.m_en: overwhelmed, a happy sob of faith, from the heart

rs_38.m: 喜乐、笃定，直接对孩子说；慢而清楚
rs_38.m_en: joyful and sure, straight to the child; slow and clear

rs_39.m: 温暖，带着笑；最后的应许轻轻地说
rs_39.m_en: warm, a smile, a hush on the promise at the end
